title: Master Pin Registry — Pin record
description: One atomic Pin in the Spiderweb-PR Master Pin Registry. A Pin is any mapped object, place, asset, event location, signal, anomaly, candidate, infrastructure node, or analytic marker that can be spatially referenced and assigned evidence metadata. Replaces the legacy POI / Entity / Feature / Location vocabulary (GeoJSON `Feature`/`FeatureCollection` wire constants are NOT renamed — they are the RFC 7946 serialization format, distinct from a Pin). Optional distributed ILAP fields let a Pin act as a subcomponent node inside a broader ILAP Area / ILAP Cluster without treating the Pin as proof of subsurface infrastructure.

pin_layer.description: Source GIS layer / table holding one geometry type or schema variant.

ilap_area_id.description: Optional broader ILAP Area assignment. The area is a geographic operating zone, not a claim of access.

ilap_cluster_id.description: Optional distributed ILAP Cluster assignment. A cluster is a system-level grouping of subcomponent nodes.

node_role.description: Functional role of the Pin inside the cluster hypothesis.

system_function.description: Inferred system-level function. Use context_only or unknown when evidence is weak.

cluster_coherence_score.description: Cluster-level coherence score copied to or computed for the Pin after rescore.

contradiction_flags.description: Source/model conflicts that reduce confidence or force review.
